name: Name
stayTip: You stay signed in for as many days as your account has set under Security, 30 if you never picked a number. Without the switch the session ends when you close the browser.
codeTip: The app shows a new six digit code every 30 seconds. Without your phone, one of your recovery codes works too.
logCodeTip: The code is in the log of the CannonCommander container: on Unraid in the Docker tab, click the icon, then Logs. It works for 10 minutes. The reset ends all other sessions, turns off two factor sign in and revokes all API tokens.
ownText: Before you start, your account gets a password of its own. The one from the log stops working then.
setupText: This server asks for a second factor at every sign in. Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the six digits.
codesText: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one gets you in once, should your phone be missing.
codeSent: The code is in the container log now
bye: You are signed out. See you soon!
again: Your session ran out. Please sign in again.
wrong: The name or the password is not right.

tooMany.one: Too many tries. Please wait {n} minute and try again.
tooMany.other: Too many tries. Please wait {n} minutes and try again.

noPasswords: This server does not take passwords.
stale: That took a little too long. Please sign in again.
badCode: The code does not match. Take a fresh one from the app or a recovery code.
badSetupCode: The code does not match. Is the clock on your phone right?
needName: Enter your name first. CannonCommander then writes the code to its log.
twelve: The code has twelve characters, just as it is in the log.

short.one: The new password needs at least {n} character.
short.other: The new password needs at least {n} characters.

differ: The two passwords are not the same.
same: Please pick a password other than the old one.
badReset: The code is not right or ran out. Please ask for a new one.
passkeyFailed: This passkey does not sign in here.
passkeyOff: Passkeys are turned off on this server.
offline: CannonCommander does not answer right now. Please try again in a moment.
